svg.text: No external IPs anywhere · Shielded VMs (secure boot, vTPM, integrity) · OS Login, project SSH keys blocked · SSH only via IAP

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Firewall policy per VPC: allow-list first, then an explicit logged deny-all (the implicit deny is silent) · non-overlapping CIDRs required by NCC

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Least privilege: VM service accounts hold no roles · operator gets IAP tunnel + OS Login only · state in a versioned, private bucket

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Operator authenticates to IAP with their Google identity and is tunnelled to a private VM. Nothing is exposed to the internet

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each VPC is a spoke on the NCC hub. Hub = center group; prod and dev = edge group (edges reach the center, never each other)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Allowed path: prod↔hub and dev↔hub via routes NCC exports; proven by Connectivity Tests and live curl

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blocked path: no route between edge spokes; Connectivity Test says UNREACHABLE and live curl times out
